{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=17|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**The [[Government of Italy|Italian government]] announces it will take over the [[flag carrier]] [[Alitalia]] as part of its emergency response to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.thelocal.it/20200317/italy-announces-plan-to-re-nationalise-struggling-alitalia-airline (Italy Local)]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] textile design company [[Laura Ashley plc]] collapses into administration, saying the coronavirus has had a "significant impact on trading". [https://inews.co.uk/news/business/laura-ashley-administration-stores-closing-down-jobs-coronavirus-trading-2479092 (iNews)]
*British multinational electrical and telecommunications retailer [[Dixons Carphone]] says it is closing all standalone [[Carphone Warehouse]] stores in the UK, with the loss of 2,900 jobs, as part of a company restructuring. The closures are not believed to be related to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-dixons-carphone-outlook/dixons-carphone-to-close-531-uk-stores-and-cut-2900-jobs-idUKKBN2140U8 (Reuters)]
;Health and environment 
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Pfizer]] signs a deal with {{ill|BioNTech|WD=Q36413541}} to help develop a vaccine. [https://www.usnews.com/news/top-news/articles/2020-03-17/pfizer-biontech-to-co-develop-potential-coronavirus-vaccine (US News)]
***[[China]] gives go-ahead for [[Clinical trial|human trials]] for a potential vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-china-vaccine-idUSKBN2141TI (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[Wuhan]], where the [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|coronavirus]] originated, will require returnees to be [[quarantine]]d for 14 days. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/chinas-wuhan-will-require-all-overseas-returnees-to-undergo-quarantine (''National Post'')]
****[[China]] reports only one domestic case of COVID-19, but found 20 cases that were imported abroad. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/03/17/china-reports-just-1-new-domestic-virus-case-20-more-imported.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Japan]]
****The President of the [[Japan Football Association]] and deputy Olympic Committee chief [[Kozo Tashima]] tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [[Japan]] insists the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] will still go ahead as planned. [https://www.brecorder.com/2020/03/17/580825/japan-olympic-committee-deputy-head-has-coronavirus-statement/ (Business Recorder)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia]]
***A 37-year-old [[Woolworths Supermarkets|Woolworths]] employee is stabbed by a 25-year-old man in [[Rosebud, Victoria]]. The crime is believed to be related to mass [[panic buying]] across [[Australia]]n supermarkets that has seen cases of violence between shoppers and staff members. ([https://www.news.com.au/national/victoria/news/man-allegedly-stabbed-in-woolies-in-victorias-mornington-peninsula/news-story/4817e2e2bec6798855857ac048937e3f News.com.au])
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Malaysia]]
***[[Malaysia]] reports its first two deaths from COVID-19 as the total number of confirmed cases in the country rises to 673. The victims of the virus were a 60-year-old from [[Kuching]] and a 34-year-old from [[Johor]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-reports-first-death-from-coronavirus (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Iran]] temporarily frees 85,000 prisoners, including [[Political prisoner|political ones]] and British-Iranian dual national [[Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe]], amid the coronavirus outbreak in the country. A judiciary spokesman says all of those freed were serving less than five years in prison, while all other prisoners serving heavier sentences remain in jail. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran-prisoners/iran-temporarily-frees-85000-prisoners-including-political-ones-amid-coronavirus-idUSKBN21410M (Reuters)]
***Iran's [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 1,178 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 135 more deaths, bringing the total to 16,169 cases and 988 deaths. [https://www.newindianexpress.com/world/2020/mar/17/in-new-spike-iran-says-135-more-people-died-of-coronavirus-2117863.html (''New Indian Express'')]
***[[Sharif University]] publishes a study about the number of possible casualties, warning that it could reach millions of deaths if a full quarantine is not imposed. [https://apnews.com/6e92d93551ee6c6ae51d0acaaad9eb32 (AP news)]
***Iran bans the traditional Persian fire festival [[Chaharshanbe Suri]]. [https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/iran_bans_fire_festival_celebrations-over-virus/1769048 (Outlook India)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***The [[European Union]] closes its external border for first time in its history. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/17/europe/europe-shuts-its-borders-to-stop-coronavirus-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
****Former Prime Minister [[Silvio Berlusconi]] announces a 10 million euros donation to [[Lombardy]] to arrange a temporary 400-bed hospital at [[Fiera Milano|Milan trade fair]]. ([http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2020/03/17/berlusconi-gives-10-mn-to-lombardy_699fb725-fa9a-4b54-addd-6133e6a98c45.html ANSA])
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 2,000 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 182 more deaths, raising the total to 11,178 cases and 491 deaths. The [[Balearic Islands]] regional government asks tourists to return home and closes airports and ports. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/amp/world-europe-51927790 (BBC)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****[[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] declares a [[state of emergency]] over COVID-19. The [[Armed Forces of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian military]] is directed to set up tent quarantines on the border with [[Republika Srpska]], which itself has declared a state of emergency. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-bosnia/bosnia-declares-nationwide-state-of-emergency-over-coronavirus-pm-idUSKBN2142FH (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Montenegro]]
****[[Montenegro]] reports its first two confirmed cases of COVID-19 in two female patients who had recently returned from abroad. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-03-17/montenegro-reports-first-case-of-corona-virus-infection (U.S. News)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Monaco]]
****For first time in his reign, [[Albert II of Monaco|Albert II]] addresses to the Nation in a serious speech reporting on the strengthening of quarantine measures. [https://www.monacomatin.mc/sante/face-a-lune-des-pires-crises-sanitaires-le-prince-albert-ii-annonce-le-renforcement-des-mesures-de-confinement-en-principaute-482387 (Monaco Matin)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] records their first death from COVID-19 in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]] state. [https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/brazil-records-first-coronavirus-death-says-sao-paulo-state-2020-03-17 (Nasdaq)]
***Hundreds of inmates escape from a prison in [[Mongaguá]] after rioting over new coronavirus restrictions. Riots and escapes are also reported at prisons in [[Mirandópolis]], [[Porto Feliz]] and [[Tremembé]] with as many as 1,000 prisoners on the loose; at least 174 have been recaptured by police. [https://metro.co.uk/2020/03/17/hundreds-inmates-escape-prison-coronavirus-riots-brazil-12410748/ (Metro)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***The U.S. reports its 105th death from COVID-19 (54 of them in [[Washington (state)|Washington state]]) with a total of at least 5,748 confirmed cases nationwide. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/03/health/us-coronavirus-cases-state-by-state/index.html (CNN)] 
***As of today, 91,000 American [[K–12]] schools are closed in 39 states, affecting 41.6 million students and their families. [https://www.edweek.org/ew/section/multimedia/map-coronavirus-and-school-closures.html (''Education Week'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in South Carolina]]
****After 47 cases of COVID-19 are confirmed in the state, outgoing [[Chief of Staff]] [[Mick Mulvaney]] goes under self-quarantine in [[South Carolina]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/outgoing-acting-white-house-chief-of-staff-mick-mulvaney-under-self-quarantine-coronavirus/ (CBS News)] [https://www.scdhec.gov/infectious-diseases/viruses/coronavirus-disease-2019-covid-19/monitoring-testing-covid-19 (South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] reports 11 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 than yesterday, for a total of 65. [https://www.wzzm13.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/michigan-coronavirus-cases/69-07eb656a-6f3d-4cf4-8595-d775835428d6 (WZZM)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Alabama]]
****[[Alabama]] reports a total of 39 cases of COVID-19 and announces the prohibition of gatherings of 25 people or more in six counties. [https://www.wsfa.com/2020/03/17/adph-update-public-covid-am/ (WSFA)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[New York (state)|New York]] confirms its 12th death from COVID-19, and 1,374 cases total, 432 more than yesterday. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/17/nyregion/coronavirus-new-york-update.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in West Virginia]]
****[[West Virginia]] confirms its first case of COVID-19, becoming the last U.S. state to do so. [[Governor of West Virginia|Governor]] [[Jim Justice]] ordered restaurant dining rooms, bars, and casinos to close  for two weeks. [https://pittsburgh.cbslocal.com/2020/03/17/coronavirus-in-west-virginia-state-reports-first-positive-covid-19-case/ (CBS)] [https://www.wsaz.com/content/news/Gov-Jim-Justice-confirms-case-of-COVID-19-in-West-Virginia-568875791.html (WSAZ)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Arizona]]
****Several cities in [[Arizona]] declare states of emergency amidst the crisis, with [[Phoenix, Arizona|Phoenix]] and [[Tucson, Arizona|Tucson]] closing all bars and switching restaurants to take-out only until further notice. [https://www.abc15.com/news/region-phoenix-metro/central-phoenix/phoenix-to-close-bars-move-restaurants-to-delivery-and-takeout-only-as-mayor-declares-state-of-emergency (ABC15)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Delaware]]
****[[Delaware]] confirms eight new presumptive cases of COVID-19, bringing the total of such cases to 16. [http://www.wboc.com/story/41906635/first-covid19-case-in-sussex-county-reported-state-cases-double (WBOC)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Illinois]]
****The air traffic control tower at [[Midway International Airport]] in [[Chicago]] closes after several technicians employed there tested positive for COVID-19. [[Chicago Air Route Traffic Control Center]] will control the airport and its airspace until cleaning is completed. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/17/faa-says-tower-at-chicagos-midway-airport-is-closed-after-several-air-traffic-controllers-test-positive-for-covid-19.html (CNBC)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Canada]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ontario]]
****[[Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces a state of emergency, closing restaurants, day cares, and all schools. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6688074/ontario-doug-ford-coronavirus-covid-19-march-17/ (Global News)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Turkey]]
***[[Turkey]] reports its first death from COVID-19, while the number of confirmed cases increases to 98. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-reports-first-coronavirus-death-as-number-of-cases-jumps-to-98/news (''Daily Sabah'')]

;International relations
*[[Accession of North Macedonia to NATO]]
**The [[Senate of Spain]] ratifies [[North Macedonia]]'s accession protocol for [[NATO]], becoming the last of NATO's 30 members to do so. The move formally paves the way for North Macedonia to join the military alliance. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/nato-door-open-to-north-macedonia-after-spains-approval (Daily Sabah)]

;Law and crime
*Hashem Abedi, the brother of [[Manchester Arena bombing|Manchester Arena bomber]] Salman Ramadan Abedi, is found guilty of 22 murders. [https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/manchester-bombers-brother-convicted-22-counts-murder-69645673 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
**Voters in [[Arizona]], [[Florida]], and [[Illinois]] go to the polls in their primary elections. [https://www.businessinsider.com/florida-democratic-primary-live-results-vote-counts-2020-3 (Business Insider)] [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/primary-results-march-17-2020/index.html (CNN)]
**Former [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] wins all three states, increasing his delegate count to 1,180, while [[United States Senator|U.S. Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] now has 885. The minimum required to win the nomination is 1,991. [https://www.businessinsider.com/florida-democratic-primary-live-results-vote-counts-2020-3 (Business Insider)] [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/primary-results-march-17-2020/index.html (CNN)]
**Incumbent [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] wins enough delegates to clinch the Republican nomination. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-wins-enough-delegates-to-become-gops-presumptive-nominee (PBS)]
**[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on politics]]
***[[Maryland]] postpones its [[2020 Maryland Democratic primary|primary]] from April 28 to June 2, becoming the fifth state to do so. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/maryland-becomes-fifth-state-to-delay-primaries-over-coronavirus-2020-03-17/ (CBS News)]
***[[Ohio]] was scheduled to vote today, but the election was postponed until June 2 due to the [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ohio|coronavirus pandemic]]. The delay capped hours of confusion in which the election was called off by the state's governor, [[Mike DeWine]], only for a judge to then rule that he did not have the authority to do so. The state's health director, [[Amy Acton]], then called off the election on the grounds of a health emergency. [https://www.dispatch.com/news/20200316/coronavirus-ohio-election-called-off-by-health-director-despite-judgersquos-ruling (''Columbus Dispatch'')] [https://www.cleveland.com/open/2020/03/citing-health-emergency-ohio-officials-to-order-polls-closed-on-election-day-despite-judges-ruling.html (''Cleveland Plain Dealer'')] 
*[[Politics of Belgium]]
**[[Sophie Wilmès]] is sworn in as [[Prime Minister of Belgium]]. Seven opposition parties have pledged to support the [[Minority government|minority]] [[Wilmès II Government|government]]—in its previous composition—with [[plenary power]] for three to six months to handle the [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Belgium|coronavirus pandemic in Belgium]]. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/sophie-wilmes-legt-eed-af-als-premier~adca7ad7/ (''Het Laatste Nieuws'')] [https://www.dhnet.be/actu/belgique/sophie-wilmes-a-prete-serment-en-tant-que-premier-ministre-5e70a283d8ad582f3193cba6 (''La Dernière Heure'')]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
**[[UEFA]] postpones the [[Euro 2020]] [[association football]] tournament until summer 2021 in response to the coronavirus pandemic in Europe. [https://www.skysports.com/football/news/19692/11958779/euro-2020-postponed-until-summer-of-2021-following-coronavirus-pandemic (Sky Sports)]
**[[CONMEBOL]] postpones the [[Copa America 2020]] association football tournament until 2021 in response to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://globoesporte.globo.com/futebol/futebol-internacional/noticia/oficial-copa-america-e-adiada-para-2021-por-causa-da-pandemia-do-coronavirus.ghtml (Globo Esporte)]
**The [[2020 French Open]] tennis tournament is postponed until late September. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/17/sports/tennis/french-open-postponed.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[2019–20 NBA season]]
***[[Brooklyn Nets]] player [[Kevin Durant]] and three of his teammates test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/17/us/kevin-durant-nets-coronavirus-spt-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 NFL season]]
**Longtime [[New England Patriots]] quarterback [[Tom Brady]] announces he will not re-sign with the team, and will instead select free agency. [http://www.nfl.com/news/story/0ap3000001106575/article/tom-brady-announces-he-wont-return-to-patriots (National Football League)]
